title: Effects of endocrine disrupting chemicals on the expression of RACK1 and LPS-induced THP-1 cell activation.
authors: Masi, Mirco; Maddalon, Ambra; Iulini, Martina; Linciano, Pasquale; Galbiati, Valentina; Marinovich, Marina; Racchi, Marco; Corsini, Emanuela; Buoso, Erica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究内分泌干扰物对RACK1表达及THP-1细胞活化的影响，仅用分子对接辅助验证配体-受体结合，核心是免疫毒理而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The existence of a complex hormonal balance among glucocorticoids, androgens and estrogens involved in the regulation of Receptor for Activated C Kinase 1 (RACK1) expression and its related immune cells activation, highlights the possibility to employ this protein as screening tool for the evaluation of the immunotoxic profile of endocrine disrupting chemicals (EDCs), hormone-active substances capable of interfering with the physiologic hormonal signaling. Hence, the aim of this work was to investigate the effect of the exposure of EDCS 17alpha-ethynylestradiol (EE), diethyl phthalate (DEP) and perfluorooctanesulfonic acid (PFOS) on RACK1 expression and on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced activation of the human monocytic cell line THP-1, a validated model for this investigation. In line with our previous results with estrogen-active compounds, EE treatment significantly induced RACK1 promoter transcriptional activity, mRNA expression, and protein levels, which paralleled an increase in LPS-induced IL-8, TNF-alpha production and CD86 expression, previously demonstrated to be dependent on RACK1/PKCbeta activation. EE mediates its effect on RACK1 expression through G-protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER) and androgen receptor (AR) ligand-independent cascade, as also suggested by in silico molecular docking simulation. Conversely, DEP and PFOS induced a dose-dependent downregulation of RACK1 promoter transcriptional activity, mRNA expression, and protein levels, which was mirrored by a reduction of IL-8, TNF-alpha production and CD86 expression. Mifepristone pre-treatments abolish DEP and PFOS effects, confirming their GR agonist profile, also corroborated by molecular docking. Altogether, our data confirm that RACK1 represents an interesting target of steroid active compounds, which expression offers the opportunity to screen the immunotoxic potential of different hormone-active substances of concerns due to their human exposure and environmental persistence.
abstract_zh: 糖皮质激素、雄激素和雌激素之间复杂的激素平衡参与调控活化C激酶1受体（RACK1）的表达及其相关免疫细胞激活，这凸显了将该蛋白用作筛选工具的可能性，以评估内分泌干扰化学物（EDCs）的免疫毒性特征，这些物质是具有激素活性的物质，能够干扰生理性激素信号传导。因此，本研究旨在探讨暴露于EDCs 17α-乙炔雌二醇（EE）、邻苯二甲酸二乙酯（DEP）和全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）对RACK1表达及脂多糖（LPS）诱导的人单核细胞系THP-1激活的影响，该细胞系是此研究的验证模型。与我们先前使用雌激素活性化合物的结果一致，EE处理显著诱导RACK1启动子转录活性、mRNA表达和蛋白水平，这伴随着LPS诱导的IL-8、TNF-α产生和CD86表达的增加，先前已证明这些依赖于RACK1/PKCβ激活。EE通过G蛋白偶联雌激素受体（GPER）和雄激素受体（AR）非配体依赖性级联介导其对RACK1表达的影响，这也由计算机分子对接模拟所提示。相反，DEP和PFOS诱导RACK1启动子转录活性、mRNA表达和蛋白水平的剂量依赖性下调，这反映在IL-8、TNF-α产生和CD86表达的减少上。米非司酮预处理消除了DEP和PFOS的作用，证实了它们的GR激动剂特性，这也通过分子对接得到佐证。总体而言，我们的数据证实RACK1是类固醇活性化合物的有趣靶点，其表达为筛选不同激素活性物质的免疫毒性潜力提供了机会，这些物质因其人类暴露和环境持久性而备受关注。
